name: Snowman
desc: Three stacked snowballs modeled by light with a coal smile, carrot nose and top hat, wobbling top-heavy through a shimmy, an overhead twig-wave, or a slow melt-and-reform under drifting snow.

hue.doc: ambient snow tint / glow hue (210 = cold moonlight)

y.doc: anchor y as canvas fraction (base on ground)

pose.doc: pose preset; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: aesthetic: light-modeled charcoal snow / cool sumi wash / stark engraved print / wireframe x-ray

act.doc: multi-minute pose dramaturgy used when pose=auto
